## Objectives
- Understand the scope and expectations of the course.  
- Preview themes: international trade, finance, global issues.  
- Situate Japan in the world economy.  

## Key Concepts
- International trade and finance: definitions and scope.  
- Japan’s economic profile (GDP, demographics, trade dependence).  
- The role of case-based learning.  

## Readings (Suggested)
- Ito and Hoshi (2020), chapter 1-3 
- Feenstra, Robert C., Robert Inklaar and Marcel P. Timmer (2015), "The Next Generation of the Penn World Table" American Economic Review, 105(10), 3150-3182, available for download at www.ggdc.net/pwt

## Discussion Questions
1. What makes Japan’s development path analytically interesting?  
2. Why analyze trade and finance together?
